name: Detour
summary: Sends messages through extra steps or straight to their destination depending on a switch the control bus holds, so that validation or debugging can be turned on without a deployment.

roles.name: Detour
roles.summary: The router with two outputs and a state told to it from outside: one output is the ordinary destination, the other the way round through steps that inspect or modify. Unlike a wire tap it can change what arrives, which is why it is worth knowing where one is before reading a message that looks wrong.
